photo.alt: The Lesser Antilles seen from the International Space Station
photo.credit: Earth Science and Remote Sensing Unit, Lyndon B. Johnson Space Center, Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons

facts: Saint Lucia to the north, Barbados to the east, Grenada to the south
worth_knowing: Seven of the islands are inhabited, the largest and most populous being Bequia, Mustique, Canouan and Union Island.
